scope: Native source adaptation. Tests of state mutation are not a claim of original whole-game equivalence.
changes: DOS 16-bit cell indices use int16_t; host loop counters use int.
Global board state moved to an explicit BCBoard context.
DOS far qualifiers and union byte aliasing removed.
Board decoder rejects invalid side/kind and more than 16 pieces per side atomically.
Empty-cell sentinel piece-index 16 writes are suppressed instead of writing outside host arrays.
Board codec unpack omits original game-state, graphics, and turn side effects; not yet a replacement for dispatch_8d73.
Original apply/undo caller obligations remain: legal move and current mover side, with higher-level search state saved/restored separately.
Asset preview scheduling is illustrative 10 fps, not recovered task timing.
